''See also: [[Elderspawn Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Elderspawn are the diverse and often monstrous servants of the [[Great Elders]]. They vary significantly in appearance, biology, and intelligence, ranging from animalistic creatures with little thought to highly intelligent, ancient beings. Some possess specialized forms, such as the ten-legged arachnid [[Inquisitors|Inquisitors of Ach’magut]], the parasitic [[Shades of Urg’naut]], or [[giant worms]] and amphibious hordes associated with other [[Great Elders]]. While some are viewed as mindless monsters, others exhibit coordinated behavior and precise timing that suggests a higher intelligence at work. These entities are characterized by their alien nature, often possessing multiple eyes, tentacles, or specialized limbs. Their [[blood]] is frequently described as purple, and their deaths can produce unsettling sounds. While some Elderspawn are purely malicious or driven by instinct, others may act with a specific purpose or mission, sometimes appearing indifferent to humans unless disturbed. They are capable of immense [[destruction]], such as tearing open prisons or causing massive environmental disturbances, and can exist in a state of long-term dormancy. In combat, they are targeted by specialized groups like the [[Blackwatch]] and the [[Consultants]], though more powerful versions, such as [[Handmaidens]], are significantly harder to defeat.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|These [[giant]], clawed creatures possess highly varied and alien biology, ranging from lime-green beings with six yellow eyes and webbed feet to dark blue or purple chitinous forms. Some variations feature ten spear-sharp spider legs, while others have dark green skin, small wings, tentacles over their mouths, or eyes on stalks located on their backs. They can also manifest as fanged fish with stubby limbs, [[giant]] flatworms with crocodile teeth, or even entities lacking heads, hearts, spines, or limbs.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Elderspawn exist in a perpetual state of burning frustration and malice, though they are not necessarily malicious by nature. They do not care about humans and can exhibit a hive-like shared mind or animalistic intelligence, such as in the case of [[Shuffles]]. Some may possess the ability to command others or act as guides for Navigators.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] keeps captive Elderspawn and uses an orange-and-black [[sword]] against them. [[Sleepless|The Sleepless]] use Elderspawn as messengers to translate their voices and report back to their leaders. They have served [[Jerri]] by assisting with her waste and food during her imprisonment, and [[Lucan]] has fought against them. [[Meia]] has killed a [[giant]] specimen with her bare hands, while [[Kerian]] used the [[Veil]] to sweep an army of them away.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Elderspawn can be summoned through the application of [[Intent]] and are capable of imitating human voices or borrowing a person's face. They can be immobilized by contact with [[Awakened iron]] and cannot pass through the [[Bastion's Veil|Bastion’s Veil]] mist. Some individuals may have developed the power to command others, and their deaths produce floating green lights.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|General characteristics}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|An Elderspawn is a clawed creature that [[Calder]] was forced to nail to the inside of his hull.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c1">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 1</ref> These entities do not experience tiredness in the same manner as humans.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 3</ref> The term Elderspawn also serves as a measure for volume and loudness.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c7">''Of Sea and Shadow'', chapter 7</ref> Furthermore, the Elderspawn possesses an awareness that [[Calder]] is able to read.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c7" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">4</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|An [[Elderspawn]] is a clawed creature that [[Calder]] had to nail to the inside of his hull.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|[[Elderspawn]] are creatures that may not get tired in the human sense.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The volume of [[Elderspawn]] is a measure for loudness.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The [[Elderspawn]] is an entity with awareness that can be read by [[Calder]].<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c7" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Elderspawn]] include [[Shuffles]], who have little intelligence more than animals.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Elderspawn]] are hordes that can kneel.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c23" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Battles in the Capital}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|During the battles in the Capital, [[Kerian]] once swept an army of these creatures from the shores by collapsing the [[Veil]], and their deaths result in floating green lights.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c2">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 2</ref> Following a battle with the Elderspawn, several girls survived an encounter with one of the beings.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c4">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c6">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 6</ref> The Guard leader eventually identifies [[Darius Allbright|Darius]] as an Elderspawn, a creature that can borrow a person's face.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c8">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 19</ref> These beings created the bronze door in the tunnel and are characterized by a shifting, skittering movement.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 9</ref> More hideous than any [[Kameira]], the Elderspawn possess eyes on stalks located on their backs and show no concern for humans.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9" /><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c18">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 18</ref> The creatures possess sickening purple [[blood]] and emit death-screams that sound like a blend of a whistling teakettle and a screaming horse.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c16">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 16</ref> As the Elderspawn are being cleansed from the Capital, the possibility of further fighting remains.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c7">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c16" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">14</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The deaths of [[Elderspawn]] produce floating green lights.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c2" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Kerian]] swept an army of [[Elderspawn]] from the shores by collapsing the [[Veil]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c2" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|There was a battle with the [[Elderspawn]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The girls survived a meeting with an [[Elderspawn]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|There is a possibility of a fight with [[Elderspawn]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The Guard leader identifies [[Darius Allbright|Darius]] as an [[Elderspawn]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Elderspawn]] created the bronze door in the tunnel.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|An [[Elderspawn]] is a creature that moves with a shifting, skittering movement.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Elderspawn]] creature has eyes on stalks positioned on its back.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Elderspawn]] are creatures that do not care about humans.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Elderspawn]] have sickening purple [[blood]] and death-screams that sound like a blend of a screaming horse and a whistling teakettle.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c16" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Elderspawn]] are being cleansed from the Capital.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c16" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|An [[Elderspawn]] is a creature more hideous than any [[Kameira]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Elderspawn]] are beings that can borrow a person's face.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Messengers of the Sleepless}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Elderspawn messengers serve as translators for the voices of the [[Sleepless]] [[cabal]] and report their findings back to the [[Sleepless]] leaders.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c5">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 5</ref> After [[Estyr]] identified an Elderspawn, it was noted that silver rings can be used to ward them off.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 9</ref> These creatures may be encircling the tower, with [[giant]] fanged specimens appearing in the surf.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c10">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c12">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 12</ref> Physically, they are lime-green creatures featuring six yellow eyes, a dozen webbed amphibian feet, and stingers.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c12" /> As [[giant]] flatworms, they possess extendible jaws filled with crocodile teeth and have the ability to affect the mind and body of [[Mister Goss]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 14</ref> [[Calder]] referenced seeing Elderspawn during his speech, noting that these creations of [[Othaghor]] are subject to a holy zeal for eradication from some [[Pilgrims]] during the [[Awakening]] process.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c16">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 17</ref> While they served [[Jerri]] by disposing of waste and dragging food to her during her imprisonment, they are ultimately servants of [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 20</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">15</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] messengers translate the voices of the [[Sleepless]] [[cabal]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c5" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] report back to the [[Sleepless]] leaders.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c5" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Estyr]] identified something or someone as an [[Elderspawn]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Silver]] rings are used to ward off [[Elderspawn]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] may be encircling the tower.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Giant fanged [[Elderspawn]] are in the surf.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] are lime-green creatures with six yellow eyes and a dozen webbed amphibian feet.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] have stingers.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c12" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Some [[Pilgrims]] gain a holy zeal toward the eradication of [[Elderspawn]] due to the [[Awakening]] process.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] are servants of [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Capital siege}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Elderspawn are creatures that inhabit the areas surrounding the Capital, leading ordinary citizens to invest in objects for their protection.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 21</ref> These fanged fish possess stubby arms and legs with claws, and they were seen seething in a mass beneath the [[water]]'s surface.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 24</ref> The dark waters were filled with Elderspawn corpses, which [[Calder]] snapped as he marched forward.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" /> While the [[Awakened sword]] was specifically designed to combat these entities, pieces of both Elderspawn and human corpses were observed stitching themselves together.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 25</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">8</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] are creatures that exist around the Capital.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Ordinary people in the Capital invested objects to protect them from [[Elderspawn]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A mass of aquatic [[Elderspawn]] seethed beneath the surface.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] are fanged fish with clawed, stubby legs and arms.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[water]] was dark with [[Elderspawn]] corpses.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder]] snaps [[Elderspawn]] as he marches forward.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Elderspawn]] are entities that the [[Awakened sword]] was designed to be used against.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Pieces of [[Elderspawn]] and human corpses were stitching themselves together.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Certain members of the Elderspawn function with a collective hive mind.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c5">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 5</ref> The term is frequently used by [[Estyr]] as a way to express intense fury and hatred.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref> During the siege, [[Darius Allbright|Allbright]] proposes a plan to flush these creatures out of the [[Imperial]] Palace.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref> The Elderspawn are unable to traverse the mist of the [[Bastion's Veil|Bastion’s Veil]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 13</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">4</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Some [[Elderspawn]] share a mind like a hive.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c5" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Estyr]] uses the term '[[Elderspawn]]' as a declaration of hatred and fury.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Darius Allbright|Allbright]] suggests flushing out the [[Elderspawn]] from the [[Imperial]] Palace.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Elderspawn]] cannot pass through the [[Bastion's Veil|Bastion’s Veil]] mist.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Global uprising}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|On the night of the Emperor's death, an Elderspawn uprising occurred across the globe.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 14</ref> These creatures, which can be crafted as a means for the [[Creeping Shadow]] to influence the world, are vulnerable to the light of [[Loreli]]'s Beacon.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 20</ref> The Elderspawn were capable of driving out some [[Great Elder tombs|Elder tombs]] and could be seen pooling at [[Darius Allbright]]'s feet or clinging to walls.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 22</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref> An army of these beings was spotted in the distance, while others were found on decks and in the [[water]] surrounding the Navigators.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 25</ref> Made of flesh and bone, the Elderspawn are even able to crawl up railings.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 26</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">9</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|There was an uprising of [[Elderspawn]] around the world on the night of the Emperor’s death.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Loreli]]'s Beacon light torches [[Elderspawn]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Crafting [[Elderspawn]] is a way the [[Creeping Shadow]] can influence the world.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Some [[Great Elder tombs|Elder tombs]] were driven out by [[Elderspawn]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Elderspawn]] pooled around [[Darius Allbright]]'s feet and clung to walls.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|An army of [[Elderspawn]] was seen in the distance.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Elderspawn]] are in the [[water]] around the Navigators.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Elderspawn]] were on the deck.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Elderspawn]] of flesh and bone can crawl up railings.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|In volume no less than the Elderspawn, he announced, “Danger! All hands on deck!<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c7" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|So-called “street gangs” had been the darlings of the newssheets for five years, haunting the poorer quarters like roving bands of Elderspawn.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“Sweeps all lesser Elderspawn off the Island.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c26" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|“Elderspawn! Seize him for questioning!”<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c8" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|“I had a run-in with some Elderspawn a few years back. As I was so handsome, one of them borrowed my face, and he has yet to give it back.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c19" />}}
